notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.content:
Update 1.3

Great News we Updatet Disco Time to 1.3 :)

some things like bowling and pool are not perfect yet that comes in the 1.4 version!

[h1]Changelog	[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Add New Club
    [*]Add Street with Entries to the Clubs
    [*]Add 9 New Music Tracks now have 18
    [*]Add Graphic Options
    [*]Add Interaction with dancer you can ask for a Dance and choose between 20 Dance styles
    [*]Add  New Visual Effects
    [*]Add Sound Attenuate the further you get from the speakers the quieter the sound becomes
    [*]YouTube browser improved
    [*]Add Bowling
    [*]Add Dart
    [*]Add Mini Basketball
    [*]Add Arcade Machine in future with more Games :)
    [*]Make New Screenshots and Trailer for Store Page
[/list]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L1SfCJeJuts

If you found Bugs post here!
